text: If a member's payment fails, or they dispute a charge with their bank, Scout pauses the pet's benefits until it's settled.
Remember: while benefits are paused, charge regular prices.
On Maple's chart, the Membership section says Benefits paused.
It says since when, and why: the membership payment is past due. Charge regular prices until it's settled.
Maria's card was declined, so she gives you a new one. Click Change card.
Type the name on the card, and the new card number,
and click Use this card for the membership.
Saved. Scout takes the missed payment on the new card right away, and when it goes through, the benefits are back on.
Juniper's benefits are paused for a different reason: a card dispute with Maria's bank. Settle it with the owner first. If the practice wins the dispute, benefits come back on their own.
If it's settled another way, a manager turns benefits back on with Resume benefits.
The most common mistake is giving a paused pet member prices anyway. Remember: while benefits are paused, charge regular prices.
